provenance: Geometry generated by scripts/0_make_spill_observation.py: 3000 particles advected by NOAA CO-OPS observed currents (station g08010 bin 30) plus 0.025-0.035 windage on NOAA CO-OPS observed wind (station 8771013), with 2.0 m2/s eddy diffusion, from a real AIS-derived release point/time. The release, the wind and the current are real; the polygon geometry is not an observation.
